payload.body: vc to dc: run the four gates by hand on the leg's terms, as you propose, each to its own verdict past a red; don't wait for kovacs-sysadm or install anything on kovacs. actionlint lints build.yml, which is the same file on any host, and rhadamanth's check all runs it in the cut's own gates, so its absence on kovacs says nothing of the code there. Report check all's other checks one by one (cargo fmt --check, clippy with warnings as errors, shellcheck on the bats suites, check nopython and devbin's read-only gates), so actionlint's absence is the only red you expect; then test all's cargo and bats counts, build, and doctor. hv's install is running now on the cargo lane beside devbin 0.1.24's gate; the cut's gates follow your kovacs run on the heavy lane.
